name: NLC India Ltd.
business_summary: Navratna PSU that mines lignite (Neyveli, Barsingsar) and coal (Talabira II & III, Odisha) and generates power: lignite stations at Neyveli (TPS-I, II, Expansion) and Barsingsar, Ghatampur (NUPPL, 3x660 MW, now fully commissioned), plus renewables via NLC India Renewables (NIRL). Tariffs are CERC cost-plus with several 2024-29 final orders pending, so interim billing applies (Ghatampur at 90%). Q2 FY27: sales Rs 2,691 cr, operating profit Rs 686 cr (OPM 25%), net profit Rs 1,205 cr per screener (company headlines quote Rs 1,328-1,381 cr, +83% to doubling; reasons not verified). Rs 1.50 interim dividend; NIRL IPO with OFS up to 10 crore shares cleared 4 Nov. Promoters 69.5%; mcap Rs 33.5k cr; P/E 10.3; stock -27% in 6 months.

revenue_mix.geography: Tamil Nadu, UP, Rajasthan, Kerala etc. (state discoms)

exposures.mechanism: Regulated PSU (CERC cost-plus: fixed charges on lignite power and mining) with P/E 10.3, div yield 1.5%; EV/MCap ~1.7 (borrowings Rs 28.2k cr vs mcap Rs 33.5k cr). +25bp on a ~10% rate => value -2.0% on a 10-year duration; low P/E and regulated pass-through => -1.5.

evidence.note: Mcap Rs 33,453 cr, P/E 10.3, borrowings Rs 28,248 cr (Sep-26)
RBI hiked repo 25 bp to 5.50% on 7 Oct 2026, first hike in ~4 years; stance calibrated tightening; cuts 'off the table' (Reuters, The Hindu, Business Standard headlines)

exposures.mechanism: Debt/equity 1.19-1.27 (consolidated) and Rs 11.3k cr CWIP; interest recoverable via tariff on operating plants but Ghatampur (1,980 MW, fully commissioned) bills at 90% interim tariff pending CERC final orders and the 2024-29 tariff orders are still pending for several stations (Q1 FY27 filing). +25bp on ~Rs 14k cr floating = Rs 35 cr = -1.0% of PAT x 1.7 x persistence 0.5 => -0.8.

evidence.note: Ghatampur fully commissioned (3x660 MW); interim billing at 90% of claimed tariff; CERC 2024-29 final tariff orders pending
RBI hiked repo 25 bp to 5.50% on 7 Oct 2026, first hike in ~4 years; stance calibrated tightening; cuts 'off the table' (Reuters, The Hindu, Business Standard headlines)

exposures.mechanism: Fixed-charge recovery is linked to availability (PAF) so volumes matter through incentive and the unscheduled/merchant slice of Ghatampur. Q2 power demand +11% pushed lignite PLF up; +3pp demand => +1.5% generation => +1.2% EBITDA x EV/MCap 1.7 x 0.5 => +1.0.

evidence.note: Sales Rs 2,691 cr in Sep-26 quarter vs Rs 2,565 cr; OPM 25%
Over half of coal plants at critically low stocks; captive plants ordered to maximise output from 1 Oct (Times of India 21 Oct, Reuters 28 Sep 2026 headlines)

exposures.mechanism: Small merchant sales from Ghatampur and Neyveli surplus; most thermal output on regulated or long-term PPAs. +15% spot => +0.5.

evidence.note: Thermal billing per CERC tariff orders; interim tariff on Ghatampur

exposures.mechanism: NLC's Talabira II & III coal block (branch: Q1 FY27 total income Rs 933 cr, PAT Rs 289 cr) and Barsingsar/Neyveli lignite mines sell fuel at regulated or auction-linked prices; Ghatampur uses Pakri-Barwadih captive coal (model knowledge). Higher domestic coal prices lift mining realisations while pass-through protects power; net small positive. +10% => +0.3.

evidence.note: Talabira branch total income Rs 932.87 cr and PAT Rs 289.44 cr for Q1 FY27
Talabira II & III coal mine record production (IntelliNews)

exposures.mechanism: Debtor days fell from 88 to 62 (screener); discom reform lowers receivable and LPS risk; CERC final tariff orders (regulatory) unlock deferred income: regulatory deferral liability Rs 413.64 cr on disputed billing. +1 SSU => +2.

evidence.note: Regulatory deferral liability Rs 413.64 cr, incl. Rs 27.13 cr interest, at 30 Jun 2026

exposures.mechanism: Renewable pivot: 10 GW target by 2030, 50:50 conventional/renewable mix by 2032 (CMD), NIRL IPO OFS of up to 10 crore shares cleared on 4 Nov 2026 (listing in FY27 per Sahi). Stronger policy (ISTS, storage, GNA) raises NIRL's value and the IPO price discovery: +3.

evidence.note: NLC India board cleared NIRL (NLC India Renewables) IPO with OFS of up to 10 crore shares; Rs 1.50 interim dividend; Rs 2,500 cr bonds; 660 MW expansion (CNBC TV18, PSU Connect, Business Today 4 Nov)
NLC targets 10 GW RE by 2030 (Indian Masterminds); Rs 37,000 cr Odisha plan (Business Standard 23 Oct)

exposures.mechanism: Renewables, storage and critical minerals expansion announced (Energetica 21 Sep 2026); 660 MW expansion and Rs 2,500 cr bond plan on 4 Nov. +1 SSU => +2.

evidence.note: NLC India board cleared NIRL (NLC India Renewables) IPO with OFS of up to 10 crore shares; Rs 1.50 interim dividend; Rs 2,500 cr bonds; 660 MW expansion (CNBC TV18, PSU Connect, Business Today 4 Nov)
NLC India expands into renewables, storage and critical minerals (Energetica India)

exposures.mechanism: Lignite and coal royalties and DMF/NMET levies sit in mining cost base (Neyveli, Barsingsar, Talabira); CERC passes through only partially for lignite mines on interim price orders (Neyveli mines billed at interim lignite price, final order pending). +1 SSU (higher royalty) => -1.0.

evidence.note: Neyveli mines billed on CERC interim lignite price order; final 2019-24 order pending

exposures.mechanism: FIIs 4.6% and DIIs 13.6%; promoter (GoI) 69.5% after a stake sale of ~2.7pp in Q1 FY27 (72.2% -> 69.47%); beta ~1.3-1.7 in pack. +5bn => +1.2.
Imported power equipment and some USD supplier credits; majority INR; wind/solar module imports for NIRL partly offset by DCR sourcing. +3% => -0.3.

evidence.note: Borrowings Rs 28,248 cr; CWIP Rs 11,306 cr
